results.content: In the **Ministry of Education, Government of India (MoE)’s** latest announcement on **30th October 2025**, the country is set to launch a **groundbreaking Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Computational Thinking (CT) curriculum** from **Class 3 onwards**, starting with the **academic session 2026-27**, for all schools. They have drafted a comprehensive Artificial Intelligence and Computational Thinking (AI & CT) curriculum for students from **Classes 3 to 12**. “**Artificial Intelligence and Computational Thinking (AI & CT)** will reinforce the concept of learning, thinking, and teaching, and will gradually expand towards the idea of ‘AI for Public Good.’ This initiative marks a nascent yet significant step towards the ethical use of AI to solve complex challenges, as the technology will be organically embedded from the foundational stage, beginning in Grade 3,” the Ministry of Education said in a statement. **CBSE’s new AI and CT curriculum** takes a significant leap towards aligning India’s education system with the global technological shifts.
